changelog: The unit volume check now compares the OUTER volume (perimeter dimensions) against each model's max applicable volume; effective storage volume, tonnage and heat load still use the internal volume (GB 50072)
Default safety margin changed to 30%, default daily door openings changed to 5

Ambient temperature is no longer capped at 37℃: both language versions read the real bands in their own capacity tables and interpolate linearly between bands; below 32℃ uses the 32℃ band, above 50℃ uses the 50℃ band with a note in the result heading
The 55℃ column in the English capacity table is pending manufacturer confirmation and is temporarily locked to 50℃
When the outbound (shipment) temperature is lower than the target set temperature, a red hint appears under the field (hint only, results unchanged)
When length, width, height or insulation thickness is left blank, a red hint appears under the field and disappears once filled
New optional "Project Name" box after calculation: when filled, the report shows the project name under the title and the downloaded file name includes it; blank keeps the default naming
Exported report (Chinese) hides four explanation blocks (internal vs outer volume, thermal resistance, effective storage, three-stage product load breakdown); the itemized load table is kept
Exported report (English) hides only the three-stage product load breakdown block; other blocks are kept
English report header: PRIMST is now shown in red; footer wording updated accordingly (no Yair)
note: PRIMST Cold Room Cooling Load Calculator - English edition. pageVersion triggers live page update; apkVersion/apkUrl trigger the APK update prompt.
